title: Personal Name
description: A person's name decomposed into given, middle, family, and full forms. Used by citizen-facing services that need to collect or display a person's legal name. Full name is optional — when omitted the renderer auto-derives it from the other fields. NOTE: the auto-derive is currently an implicit renderer contract; Feature 103 T039-T041 will make the SchemaRefResolver backfill fullName from given+middle+family at validation time so blueprints that require fullName don't reject submissions that left it blank.
